name: SegmentedControl
description: The SegmentedControl component provides a set of two or more mutually exclusive options presented as connected segments, offering a more compact and visually intuitive alternative to radio buttons or select inputs.
usage: Use SegmentedControl when you need users to choose one option from a small set of related choices.
Perfect for toggling between views, filtering options, or setting basic preferences.
Best suited for 2-5 options with short, clear labels.
Consider using radio buttons or a dropdown for more than 5 options.
Use instead of tabs when the options don't represent content panels but rather control a single setting.
design: The active segment is indicated visually with a colored underline and bolder text.
Segments maintain a consistent width unless the `fullWidth` prop is used, which distributes space evenly.
Sizes align with Button component: xs=h-7, sm=h-8, md=h-9, lg=h-12 for consistent form layouts. Use xs for compact UIs alongside Select compact.
The default variant includes subtle depth cues (shadow) while the subtle variant is flatter for less visual weight.
When disabling individual options, ensure there's a clear visual indication that they're unavailable while maintaining readability.
accessibility: A single-choice group: role="radiogroup" with role="radio" options and aria-checked (was aria-pressed buttons)
One Tab stop, on the chosen option (else the first enabled); the arrows move and select, skipping disabled options and wrapping; Home and End go to the ends; Space and Enter choose
Named by its label (aria-labelledby), or aria-label / aria-labelledby passed through
Keyboard focus ring, inset (focus-visible, 2px var(--color-border-focus)), since the group clips outside its options
The active indicator is marked with aria-hidden="true" since it's decorative
Disabled options use the native disabled attribute and are skipped by the arrows; a disabled group sets aria-disabled

props.name: id
props.description: The group's id; generated with useId() when left out

props.name: options
props.description: Array of options to display as segments

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: the chosen value. Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled: the value chosen at first

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the chosen value, value first; not called when the chosen option is chosen again

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, naming the group (aria-labelledby). Without it, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the container

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the entire control is disabled

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant for the control. Use 'xs' for compact UIs to match Select compact height.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Whether the control should take up the full width of its container

props.name: ref
props.description: The group (role="radiogroup"). Before T35 it was the outer wrapper, label included

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (aria-label, data-*…) goes to the group; an onKeyDown runs before the arrow keys and can stop them with preventDefault()
